description.narrative: (Egypt): .This activity provides technical assistance and support to public institutions involved in the administration of elections and electoral reforms and increases voter awareness and knowledge of key issues. The activity's interventions advance three programmatic objectives: (1) improving administration of electoral processes; (2) expanding public understanding and participation; and (3) informing electoral reform debates and decision-making..
